ai_summary.text:
ノエビアホールディングスは化粧品・医薬品を展開するビューティー企業グループで、売上高647億円、営業利益111億円。営業利益率17.1%と高い収益性を誇る。通販と対面販売の二つのチャネルで安定収益を確保。自己資本比率70.8%と堅固な財務基盤。営業CF79億円、FCF55億円と安定したキャッシュ創出。配当性向も高く株主還元に積極的。財務健全性スコア100点と満点評価。

1株当たり利益（EPS）は235.1円、1株当たり純資産（BPS）は1574.2円、自己資本利益率（ROE）は14.8%の水準にある。安定した配当政策を維持しながら内部留保の蓄積による成長投資と株主還元のバランスを最適化する経営方針を貫いている。

高い財務健全性と安定した収益力を兼ね備えた優良企業として、マクロ経済や業界環境の変化に柔軟に対応しながら持続的な事業成長と株主価値の最大化を両立する経営戦略を推進している。今後の経営戦略の遂行状況と事業展開の成果が中長期的な企業の成長軌道と持続可能な価値創造を決定づけていく。
ai_summary.text_en: Noevir Holdings is a beauty company group that develops cosmetics and pharmaceuticals, with sales of  64.7 billion and operating income of  11.1 billion. It boasts high profitability with an operating margin of 17.1%. Stable earnings are secured through two channels: mail order and face-to-face sales. It has a solid financial base with an equity ratio of 70.8%. Stable cash generation with operating CF of  7.9 billion and FCF of  5.5 billion. It is also highly dividend-oriented and proactive in returning profits to shareholders. Financial soundness score is a perfect 100 points.  Earnings per share (EPS) is  235.1, net assets per share (BPS) is  1574.2, and return on equity (ROE) is 14.8%. The company consistently pursues a management policy that optimizes the balance between growth investment through retained earnings and shareholder returns while maintaining a stable dividend policy.  As an excellent company with both high financial soundness and stable profitability, the company promotes a management strategy that balances sustainable business growth and maximization of shareholder value while flexibly responding to changes in the macroeconomic and industry environment. The execution of future management strategies and the results of business development will determine the company's medium- to long-term growth trajectory and sustainable value creation.
